meta.title: About Zippling - Your Partner for a New Beginning
meta.description: Discover Zippling: your trusted partner for finding the perfect home worldwide. Enjoy transparent, user-centric housing information and start your new journey with confidence.

hero.headline: Zippling: Beyond complicated home searching, we help you with a new beginning!
hero.subheadline: Find the perfect home for you, anywhere in the world.

story.title: Our Story: Why was Zippling created?
story.paragraph1: As a developer and a foreigner, the difficulties I faced finding a home in a new city became the catalyst for Zippling's creation. The unfamiliar housing system and information imbalance were common problems many people experienced.
story.paragraph2: Based on these experiences, I wanted to help users avoid wandering in uncertainty. Our goal is to gather reliable information from various trusted platforms into one place, providing a transparent and easy-to-use search experience.
story.paragraph3: Zippling is more than just a home-finding tool. It's a solution that breaks down information barriers, empowering everyone to confidently make the best choices. We aim to help you start your new life in a new city smoothly.
story.imageAlt: A cozy space where people interact

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph: To provide the best 'connection' experience, making it easy for anyone, anywhere in the world, to find their ideal home with peace of mind.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.point1: Building a global housing information hub that is easily accessible to everyone
vision.point2: Providing personalized information and an optimal search experience
vision.point3: Fostering a community based on trust and transparency
